dct_description_sm: The purpose of the project is to: (1) Determine baseline rates of sedimentation and organic carbon and nitrogen burial within Lake Melville so that it can be used in the future to assess any changes to the estuary as a result of climate change and/or industrial activity upstream, specifically, changes resulting from the development of the Muskrat Falls hydroelectric project.  (2) To develop sediment and organic carbon budgets of Lake Melville to identify the major processes responsible for the overall functioning of the system and to characterize the components within the system that may be sensitive to hydrological or climatic changes. (3) To determine any changes in rates of sedimentation and organic carbon and nitrogen burial within the modern (ca. 100 year BP) sedimentary record as a result of the damming of the Upper Churchill River in the 1970's or changing climate.
dct_title_s: Sediment and Organic Carbon Budget for Lake Melville
